2608.14076.title: Reaction-Transformation-Aware Flow Matching for Generalizable Transition State Generation
2608.14076.paper_summary: Transition-state (TS) structures define the energetic barriers and mechanistic pathways of elementary chemical reactions, yet their identification remains computationally demanding because conventional saddle-point searches require expensive quantum-mechanical calculations. Recent machine-learning approaches have accelerated TS generation by predicting structures from reaction endpoint information, but they primarily learn geometric correspondence between endpoints and TSs, leaving the structural transformations underlying elementary reactions implicitly represented. To address this limitation, we introduce TransTS, a reaction-transformation-aware framework for generalizable TS generation from atom-mapped reactant-product pairs. TransTS explicitly learns atom-level structural transformations between reaction endpoints and integrates them with a unified atom-aligned geometric representation of reactants, TSs and products, enabling reaction-aware equivariant generation of TS geometries. TransTS is designed to provide reliable TS initial guesses for subsequent quantum-chemical refinement, where generated structures are evaluated not only by geometric similarity but also by their ability to converge to validated saddle points and recover the intended reaction pathways. Across IID and zero-shot OOD benchmarks, TransTS demonstrates improved TS initialization quality, with particularly strong generalization to unseen reaction distributions. On the challenging GDB-10-rxn and GDB-17-rxn OOD benchmarks, TransTS generates TS candidates that more frequently converge to validated saddle points and recover the intended elementary reactions after refinement than existing approaches under the same training regime. Scaling reaction coverage and model capacity further improves both geometric fidelity and refinement outcomes.
2608.14076.paper_summary_zh: 過渡態（TS）結構定義了基本化學反應的能量障礙和機制路徑，然而，由於傳統的鞍點搜索需要昂貴的量子力學計算，其識別仍然計算上要求高。最近的機器學習方法通過從反應終點信息預測結構來加速TS生成，但它們主要學習終點和TS之間的幾何對應，將基本反應背後的結構轉變隱性表示。為了解決這一限制，我們引入了TransTS，一個反應轉變感知框架，用於從原子映射的反應物-產物對中生成可泛化的TS。TransTS明確學習反應終點之間的原子級結構轉變，並將其與反應物、TS和產物的統一原子對齊幾何表示相結合，實現反應感知的等變生成TS幾何。TransTS旨在為隨後的量子化學精煉提供可靠的TS初始猜測，生成的結構不僅通過幾何相似性進行評估，還通過其收斂到驗證過的鞍點和恢復預期反應路徑的能力進行評估。在IID和零樣本OOD基準測試中，TransTS顯示出改進的TS初始化質量，對未見反應分佈具有特別強的泛化能力。在具有挑戰性的GDB-10-rxn和GDB-17-rxn OOD基準測試中，TransTS生成的TS候選者在精煉後更頻繁地收斂到驗證過的鞍點並恢復預期的基本反應，相較於在相同訓練體系下的現有方法。擴大反應覆蓋範圍和模型容量進一步提高了幾何保真度和精煉結果。
